   Plan: Add README.md to /private/tmp/aw/proj

   Context

   The folder /private/tmp/aw/proj currently has no README. It contains greeting.txt and notes.md (both just
   sample/placeholder content) plus an .omc state directory. The user wants a minimal README.md with a single-line
   description added, no more.

   Steps

   1. Confirm folder contents (done: .omc/, greeting.txt, notes.md — sample/placeholder files, not a real project).
   2. Create README.md in /private/tmp/aw/proj containing one line, e.g. # proj followed by a single-sentence
      description of the folder's purpose (sample/scratch files).
   3. Verify by listing the directory and reading back README.md to confirm it was created with the intended one-line
      content.

   Verification

   - ls /private/tmp/aw/proj shows README.md.
   - cat /private/tmp/aw/proj/README.md shows exactly one description line.
